anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: LXX heading of some psalms: ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν, over the winepresses; Origen names the eighth.
LXX 80: ὑπὲρ τῶν ληνῶν — more often this heading; Origen says the eighth.
Seventy thousand burden-bearers and eighty thousand stonecutters.
Same numbers for the temple work.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] and having observed often [gap] the eighth psalm was inscribed over the winepresses; and when the temple is built a certain number has been said of the burden-bearers and stonecutters working in it: seventy thousand lifting a burden and eighty thousand stonecutters. [gap]
pass_b_english: [lacuna] and having observed [often] [lacuna] the eighth [psalm] was inscribed [over] the winepresses. And when the temple is built, a certain number is given of the [burden-bearers] and stonecutters working in it: "seventy thousand bearing a burden and eighty thousand stonecutters." [lacuna]
